summary: FOODbakēd Phase 3 Favourites — full regression. Backend pytest test_food_favourites.py: 6/6 PASS. Frontend e2e covered all 11 review scenarios: guest redirect+login dialog, guest heart→toast+dialog, dev-OTP login→heart persists (POST toggle, data-fav-active=true, server /ids returns restaurants=['burger_hub_ci']), Mes Favoris page with tabs+count badges, 1-tap reorder opens food-item-modal with variants/addons/qty, food-nav-favourites pill on /food hero, m-prof-nav-food-favs row on /profile navigates to /foodbaked/favorites, i18n toggle FR↔EN (Mes Favoris↔My Favourites, Plats↔Dishes, empty-state copy), microsite-action-favourite-burger_hub_ci on /foodbaked/restaurants/burger-hub. No regressions observed on FoodHome, restaurant microsite, or cart flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor i18n leak noticed on restaurant /order page: console warnings '[i18n] missing key customer:food.loading_menu for fr' and 'customer:food.status_open for fr'. Non-blocking but worth adding keys.
Favourites endpoints correctly require Bearer token (401 w/o auth) and are per-customer scoped (pytest covers both). Toggle is idempotent-friendly (returns favourited:boolean).
FavouriteButton exposes data-fav-active='true|false' which is excellent for test assertions. Keep the pattern consistent across other heart-style buttons.
FoodReorderDishModal re-fetches menu and re-opens standard ItemModal (data-testid=food-item-modal) — good reuse, no logic duplication with first-order flow.
test_credentials: Ephemeral dev-OTP customers: POST /api/auth/otp/request {country_code:'+225', phone:'<10 digits>'} returns dev_code in body (APP_ENV!=production); then /api/auth/otp/verify returns access_token stored at localStorage['baked_access_token'].
seed_data_creation: Each test customer favourited burger_hub_ci + burger_hub_ci_crispy_wings. Customers are ephemeral; data isolated per customer (verified via pytest + fresh customer per e2e run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: FoodHome route is /food (not /foodbaked). Favourites page is /foodbaked/favorites. Key testids: food-favourites-page, food-nav-favourites, food-fav-restaurant-<rid>, food-fav-dish-<dish_id>, food-fav-dish-reorder-<dish_id>, food-item-modal, microsite-action-favourite-<rid>, m-prof-nav-food-favs, top-nav-language-switcher, auth-open-login-btn. Dev OTP: POST /api/auth/otp/request → dev_code in response, then /verify to get access_token into localStorage['baked_access_token']. Seeded restaurant burger_hub_ci / slug burger-hub exists in CI with 9 dish hearts on /foodbaked/restaurants/burger-hub/order.
